text:
Favorite animal: owl

I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help manage the comments on your YouTube channels. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

I’m comfortable working reliably day-to-day, communicating clearly, and staying responsive for quick check-ins when needed. I also bring strong attention to detail, which helps when tracking comment activity and keeping things organized.

In a past project for Verdant Skincare, I built a marketing attribution analysis by joining ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. That work helped reallocate 18% of the ad budget and brought CAC down 12% the next quarter.

I’d be glad to support your channels consistently and grow with the role.
